description: Schedule D Tax Worksheet: a rental building bought for $300,000, $100,000 of straight-line depreciation, sold for $350,000 — $150,000 § 1231 gain to Schedule D, $100,000 unrecaptured § 1250 gain. Single, wages $100,000, taxable income 234,250: lines 18–21 put the $100,000 in line 21 (184,250, under the $197,300 top of the 24% bracket), line 39 is zero, so the unrecaptured gain is taxed at ordinary rates below 25%: 7,500 (15% of 50,000) + tax on 184,250 (37,067) = $44,567, under the regular tax $52,023.
